background: Barclays PLC is the listed holding company of the Barclays group, a UK universal bank with a large transatlantic corporate and investment bank alongside UK retail banking and international cards.
synthesis: Fitch rates the group A, S&P BBB+ and Moody's Baa1, all stable, with nothing moved since S&P's upgrade to BBB+ on 19 May 2023. Both capital and liquidity stand up well against the UK majors: CET1 of 14.3% is in the top quarter, leverage of 4.9% is above the median, and LCR of 158% and NSFR of 136% are both above their medians. The one figure that has given ground is LCR, down 20 points since 30 Jun 2025 on figures to 30 Jun 2026, from a level that still leaves ample headroom. The flagged news is persistent rather than severe: an investor-losses notice on 21 Sep 2026, repeated outages on a trading risk platform, a regulatory probe and several further items in the last 90 days.
